Undergraduate Research Volunteers (URV) Summer 2026

Advised three undergraduate students through the CICS Careers program, guiding them through the end-to-end research lifecycle. Their project explored reusing LLM representations to build hybrid models that meet latency targets on constrained devices.

UMass Summer Turing Program Summer 2026

I gave a lecture on Introduction to Machine Learning and Neural Networks to high school students, and guided a team of three through a computer science project.

My wonderful team built Professor Cheeseball’s Escape: Play the game

All the art was hand drawn. The code for the robot maze is “Cheese”. This was done interactively by controlling a mecanum robot through a maze that revealed the code at the end.
